_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_flash_cost.py. t_fc_scouring is Tegwyll's Scouring's first sentence on a cheap sorcery: castable as though it had flash by tapping three untapped creatures you control with flying. t_fc_rout is Rout's: as though it had flash if you pay {2} more. Both gain 1 life so the only thing a cast changes is what it cost.

cards.name: Test Flash Cost Scouring
cards.oracle_text:
You may cast this spell as though it had flash by tapping three untapped creatures you control with flying in addition to paying its other costs.
You gain 1 life.

cards.name: Test Flash Cost Rout
cards.oracle_text:
You may cast this spell as though it had flash if you pay {2} more to cast it.
You gain 1 life.
